title: The caller's own device credential
description: GET /v1/pairing/credential (CORE-2 §1). Authenticated with the credential it describes; answers when it was issued, when it stops working and from when it can be traded for a new one with POST /v1/pairing/renew. `expires_at` is null only for a credential the host has not yet seen since it started recording issue times, which cannot be the credential asking. `superseded` is true for a credential that was already renewed: it works until `expires_at` (the end of its grace period) and the device should be holding the new one.
